sloka: तेषां तु तुमुलं युद्धं बभूव कपिरक्षसाम्।अन्योन्यमाह्वयानानां क्रुद्धानां जयमिच्छताम् ।। ६.९६.४२ ।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ tu tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ babhūva kapirakṣasām।anyonyamāhvayānānāṁ kruddhānāṁ jayamicchatām ।। 6.96.42 ।।

translations.english: Some Vanaras ' heads were deformed, some were pierced in their hearts, and some had their ears cut off.
